about: Harmony patches into STRAFTAT's Assembly-CSharp. Each row becomes one patch class in the plugin.

rows.does: Initialize: usePhysics/useGravity off, MOVE_RATE = RocketSpeed, explosionRadius = BlastRadius, STRAFTAT damage 0.
